reviewer: Codex primary final critical reading; selected separate-reader findings retained in evidence/reviews. No human/Claude acceptance claimed.

clarity.evidence: One order-ready event becomes separate email/push deliveries, making event, delivery and attempt identities concrete.

scope.evidence: The completed answer covers outboxes, scheduling, authorization, provider outcomes, callbacks and reconciliation; local fake behavior is identified.

contracts.evidence: Stable delivery/provider identity differs from claim epoch; immutable payloads and fresh policy checks have separate ownership.

correctness.evidence: NotificationChecks covers 32 claimants and the delayed-lookup regression: authorization at 59 seconds followed by lookup after record expiry creates no second acceptance.

failure_handling.evidence: Uncertain acceptance permits read-only lookup only; absent/expired evidence quarantines. A trusted obsolete marker gates old reminders; a newer unrelated notification does not infer cancellation.

tradeoffs.evidence: At-least-once publication, provider acceptance versus delivery/read, ordering across channels and duplicate-versus-loss choices are answered.

visual_learning.evidence: NotificationTrace shows loss after provider acceptance, claim reclaim and lookup/quarantine with actual source-generated decisions.

code.evidence: examples/learning-java/src/kb/notification; full copyable source/download parity and exact excerpts checked by check_review_lot.py; actual runtime output in lot-command-output.json and lot-runtime.json.

rendering.evidence: HLD-4-browser.json: article and walkthrough in light/dark at 1280/390px; theme controls, navigation, no missing images/page-wide overflow, table contrast >=4.5. Per-topic assets resolve.

limits: Local mechanism and fixture checks do not establish remote-provider behavior, distributed durability/failover, production throughput or model quality. Scope-specific boundaries are explicit in the answer.
